decisions.reason: The semi-hard cheese wheel moved from a mention to its own page in 2019 while weaker launches were pruned, so it appears to meet aspirations, and with no evidence of a shortfall there is little trigger for problemistic search.
The spicy cheese survived the 2019 pruning and was given a dedicated page, which signals performance at or above aspiration, though a niche flavour carries somewhat more risk of a later cut.

The mild creamy soft cheese was highlighted at launch and featured on its own page in 2019, suggesting satisfactory results in a broad-appeal segment, so management would keep it rather than redirect resources.
